gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patient previously diagnosed with WHO grade 4 IDH-wildtype GBM, determined through genomic and/or histopathological analysis.

candidate_evidence.quote: [DRUG] Pembrolizumab: Treatment dosing will be 200mg of pembrolizumab every three weeks for up to six months or until disease progression

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: 6-8 patients with recurrent glioblastoma and identified mismatch repair (MMR) deficiency

flag.reason: Pembrolizumab is the only antitumour drug; focused ultrasound is a device, so coded monotherapy. Could be read as combination.

role_evidence.quote: Pembrolizumab along with focused ultrasound sonication following surgery for recurrent glioblastoma.
following microbubble (Bracco Imaging, SonoVue® or Lumason®; 0.1 mL/Kg; maximum 4.8 mL) administration on a 2-minute schedule

agents.drug_class_hint: ultrasound contrast agent used for focused-ultrasound sonication

flag.reason: Not registered as a drug intervention; part of the device procedure. Coded supportive with delivery_enabling true.
